description: Bird's-eye view of a still-life on a lightly-colored flat surface.  The still-life includes a red horse wearing a saddle and bridle in the lower right corner and a yellow plate with a round green item on it in the left central portion of the scene.  A darker stripe of horizontal color forms the upper boundary of the work. Cr no. 43 on verso.  This artwork has *Untitled (Horse)*, 1914 (cat. no. 43) on the back.
